pages.text: Gandrick is dead? You are certain?
opts: Yes. And I found his ledger.

pages.text: Corbin goes grey. "A ledger? Show me." He does not reach for it. He reaches for the sword on the wall. "I looked at the four of you and thought, here are four m
Ah, so you are the ones. News travels fast, even through the old tunnel. We heard what happened in Thornwick: the traitor Corbin, the ledger and Gandrick dead i
You are from Thornwick? Few come through that tunnel. Why have you come?
opts: Mayor Corbin sold the road to Gandrick. We found his ledger,

pages.text: I knew Corbin. I never thought he would sell his own town. Ironhill is grateful. If you want more work, I have some.
The old mines under the hill are full of the dead. Rats and bats too. Eight of them gone would let the miners work again. Will you clear them?
The mines are east of the castle, behind the gravekeeper and the foreman. Take torches.
